info.name: Ch 08 - Getting Started
info.description:
# Chapter 8: your first requests

Five GET requests to get used to the request builder and the response pane.

Before you send: start the practice API (`node server.js` in the practice-api folder) and select the environment **Practice API - Local** in the environment selector at the top right.

request.description: Is the server up? Expect `200 OK` and `"status": "UP"`.
One user as JSON. Look at the Headers tab: ETag, X-Request-Id.
The first page of users: `data` is an array of 5 users, plus `page`, `limit`, `total` and `totalPages`.

item.name: Get a user that does not exist

request.description: Expect `404 Not Found` with the standard error body.
This endpoint returns HTML. Switch the body view to **Preview** to see it rendered.
